stories.story_fr: Croissance organique du chiffre d'affaires de 4,5 % au premier trimestre 2026.
stories.story_en: Organic revenue growth of 4.5% in Q1 2026.
stories.quote: Revenue of EUR 1,547.0 million, up 4.5% organically, and down 0.8% year-on-year

stories.story_fr: Quatre acquisitions signées en 2026, apportant environ 136 M€ de revenu annualisé.
stories.story_en: Four acquisitions signed in 2026, contributing approximately EUR 136 million in annualized revenue.
stories.quote: Four acquisitions signed or completed so far this year, contributing approximately EUR 136 million in annualized revenue

stories.story_fr: Croissance organique du chiffre d'affaires de 5,7 % en glissement annuel au premier semestre 2025.
stories.story_en: Organic revenue growth of 5.7% year-on-year in H1 2025.
stories.quote: Revenue of EUR 3,192.5 million in the first half of 2025, up 5.7% year-on-year and up 6.7% organically

stories.story_fr: Amélioration de la marge opérationnelle ajustée à 15,4 % au premier semestre 2025.
stories.story_en: Adjusted operating margin improved to 15.4% in H1 2025.
stories.quote: Adjusted operating margin of 15.4%, up 44 basis points year-on-year

stories.story_fr: Annonce d'un programme de rachat d'actions de 200 M€ en février 2026.
stories.story_en: Announcement of a EUR 200 million share buyback program in February 2026.
stories.quote: EUR 200 million share buyback program announced at the end of February 2026
